reviews.title: Renewed (Refurbished) Blue Yeti Nano
reviews.comment: Works great! Sound quality is good and very similar to it's big brother, the Blue Yeti. So everyone is aware, the "Renewed" means that it is Refurbished, so the microphone was preowned and fixed. The box looking rough upon it arriving means it was either roughed up in the mail, while it was being fixed, or by the previous owner.
reviews.author: shades of silver

reviews.title: Renewed perfection!
reviews.comment: I had owned a Blue Yeti Nano from years ago, and I had always used a headset for my remote work. Just for reference, I have a couple setups in my home. A couple downstairs, a couple upstairs and each required a different headset (overkill, probably) and one of the key feedback that I got was that I sounded different based on the PCs I was sitting at. The most positive feedback was that I sounded best at the Blue Yeti Nano desk and I decided to purchase a couple renewed microphones for those other desks. All I can say is if you were worried about buying refurbished, don't be. This sounded just as good as the one I bought brand new. My product came in tip-top shape with no scuffs, or obvious damage. It looked practically new. And there are no distortions of internal damage that interrupted the audio. I am more than pleased with my purchase.
reviews.author: Chris @ Jester's Motley

reviews.title: Great value, amazing quality for renewed product
reviews.comment: A few dings here and there but it doesn't affect the overall performance of the refurbished mic. I would say it has 97% smoothness. Overall I'm very happy with this purchase because it's way cheaper than getting the brand new.
reviews.author: Jirbs

reviews.title: microUSB, great mic otherwise
reviews.comment: Works great, sounds fantastic for a usb microphone... just wish it wasn't microusb. Don't know if there's an updated USB C model, but there should be
